title: quickcheck: add lightweight oncall quick-check CLI and compact diagnostic packer
author: Ava Chen
description: Implements a small, dependency-light quick-check CLI and a compact diagnostic packer that incident responders can run from the incident channel or a runbook step. Motivation: many oncall incidents are prolonged by manual ad-hoc data collection and noisy attachments. This PR provides a safe, opinionated tool that captures a bounded set of artifacts (sanitized logs, pod status, recent traces, KV cache hints) and emits a single compressed artifact suitable for attaching to an incident thread or uploading to the internal diagnostics bucket. Key properties: fast (<= 15s typical), bounded output size (configurable default 8MB), privacy-first sanitization hooks, dry-run mode, and automatic S3-compatible upload with short-lived presigned URLs. Includes a new slash-command integration for incident-bot (/quickcheck) to trigger the CLI remotely via action runners and a small Webhook consumer used by private deployments. See linked Linear tickets ENG-3267 and ENG-3312 for rollout plan. Checklist: [x] Quick-check CLI implementation, [x] packer sanitizers and size enforcement, [x] slash-command wiring and permission checks, [x] small tutorial in docs/runbooks/quickcheck.md, [x] e2e smoke test harness, [ ] optional telemetry opt-in toggle (follow-up).
commits: 3 commits: 1) add quickcheck CLI and core packer, 2) add sanitizers, size-limiter and upload adapter, 3) wire slash-command and docs. Commit messages include minimal reproduction steps and test notes.

release_notes: Added quick-check CLI and diagnostic packer: a fast, size-limited diagnostic collector that integrates with incident-bot slash-commands. Opt-in telemetry, private-deploy S3 adapter, and docs/runbooks/quickcheck.md included.
notes_for_ops: When rolling to private deployments, ensure S3 adapter has IAM role or KMS access. Default packer size limit is 8MB; adjust for high-fidelity customers via config. We added a metric packer.duration_ms and packer.output_bytes for SLO monitoring.
post_merge_tasks: 1) follow-up ENG-3348 to stabilize uploader retries, 2) add opt-in telemetry toggle in console (PM), 3) run a controlled rollout to 10% of oncall rotations for 2 weeks and collect feedback, 4) add Conjur/KMS docs for on-prem S3 adapter.
safety_considerations: Packer runs in an ephemeral container by default and does not transmit raw tokens or secrets; sanitizers remove common secrets and the CLI has a dry-run mode to inspect what would be collected. Uploads produce short-lived presigned URLs and default retention is 72 hours. Admins can disable uploads in private deployments.
testing_notes: Includes unit tests for sanitizers, size limits and uploader mocks. E2E smoke test exercises slash-command flow against a local instance. Manual test steps in docs/runbooks/quickcheck.md. Recorded performance: median pack duration 220ms in staging for common workloads.
related_work: Related to ENG-2901 (incident automation) and the incident-bot effort to reduce mean time to mitigate. Complements the diagnostic snapshotter PRs by producing a compact, attachable file suited for quick triage rather than full forensic bundles.
